==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{UserResolution|</nowiki>{{Var|resolution}}}}</code> into your user page.

==Examples==
{| class="wikitable"
! Code !! Result
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{UserResolution|1920 &times; 1080}}</nowiki></code> || {{UserResolution|1920 &times; 1080}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{UserResolution|HD}}</nowiki></code> || {{UserResolution|HD}}
|}
